### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `HttpShardHandlerFactory.java` are directly related to addressing the bug identified in SOLR-4218, which involves preventing a NullPointerException when closing the core in the `afterClass` method of `SolrTestCaseJ4`. By ensuring that the shutdown methods are only called when the respective objects are not null, the patch enhances the robustness of the code and prevents the application from crashing due to unhandled exceptions.
